description: Branch R-PRESERVE-1 failed operations: why a refused statement changed the file hash. On a copy of the fail fixture, one kind of refusal per probe: INSERT INTO U (ID, U, N) VALUES (101, 10, 'x') (a duplicate value in the unique index UX_U), with dbFailOnError and a marked Errors read. Steps, each a read/write open, the statement, close, and a kept whole-file hash: (1) the refused statement; (2) the same refused statement again; (3) an open and close with no statement. Asks whether a refused statement changes the bytes, whether the second does, and whether the answer differs between refusal kinds (the other two kinds are separate probes).
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
